lesson_text: Live claude.ai session titles drift from the documented formats (`Issue #N — implement`, fixers without a repository, `#N · ` prefixes, project checkers renamed with a `PR #N — ` prefix), and a saved `list_sessions` result is wrapped in the harness's untrusted-data text; any script that selects sessions by title must parse the wrapper and match the live variants without catching a renamed checker.
